summary.key_theme: F5 展現強勁的財務品質與獲利能力，儘管面臨內部人賣股與國際營收波動的挑戰，市場仍對其長期成長潛力持正面看法。

bullish.title: F5 Inc (NASDAQ:FFIV) Shines as a Quality Investment

bullish.title: Unlocking F5 (FFIV) International Revenues: Trends, Surprises, and Prospects

bearish.title: Director At F5 Sells $1.56M Of Stock
bearish.reason: 董事 RAMESH NIKHIL MEHTA 出售價值 156 萬美元的股票，通常會引起市場對公司內部人對股價看法或未來展望的疑慮。
